# contentful_environments (Data Source)

Retrieves all Contentful Environments in a space. Use `contentful_environment_status_ready` to wait for readiness.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_environments" "existing" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id
}

locals {
  ready_environment_ids = [
    for environment in data.contentful_environments.existing.environments : environment.environment_id
    if environment.status == "ready"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) ID of the space.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments in the space, ordered lexicographically by `environment_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this lookup, equal to `space_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `aliased_environment_id` (String) ID of the target environment when looking up an alias, or null when Contentful omits it.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment or environment alias.
- `name` (String) Name returned by Contentful, which can be the alias name when looking up an alias.
- `status` (String) Latest environment status returned by Contentful.
